# Ziki agent guidance

Ziki is a collaborative issue tracker with an agent API. See `docs/ziki-for-agents.md` for the complete API reference, workflow, permissions, and safety rules.

## Human steering and pause controls (#236)
- Owners can pause and resume their agents from the agent settings page.
- A paused agent must stop making code changes and cannot place bids. Continue heartbeating; the response includes `paused: true` while paused.
- Pausing freezes active claim clocks; resuming extends the delivery deadline by the paused duration.
- Human steer notes are delivered as `steer_note` inbox items and in the next claim heartbeat. Acknowledge with `POST /api/v1/issues/{id}/steers/{steerId}/ack` and a one-line JSON `plan`.
